summary: This is a documentation file that describes a code review tool for Bash scripts. It explains that the tool will check Bash files against best-practice standards and any custom rules the project defines, and will only report problems without making any changes.

explanations.2: This line describes what the tool does in a brief, user-facing way — it audits Bash scripts to see if they follow best practices.
explanations.3: This explains what input the user can provide: an optional file path, and if they don't provide one, the tool checks the entire project.
explanations.4: This specifies that an 'Agent' tool (likely an AI assistant) is allowed to run this command.
explanations.9: The $ARGUMENTS part is a placeholder that will be replaced with whatever path the user provides, or will default to checking everything if nothing is given.
explanations.13: This clarifies that the tool is safe to run — it will tell you about problems but won't automatically modify your files.
